div.font:
All guards are evaluated once per step, at the top of the loop, on the sys_state as of the previous step — step! runs afterwards.
The phase never runs backwards: each transition is one-way and, once taken, its guard is no longer tested.

tr.td: zero steering; guidance and PID run but are not applied — the PID is stepped with a zero error and its output discarded, so engagement in phase 1 is bumpless
open-loop course chi_dive (≈ −85°, descending) — overrides the guidance
open-loop course chi_hold (−90°, horizontal) — overrides the guidance, so the kite arrives flat rather than still descending
attractor guidance engaged; pure course feedback; winch armed (page 2)
identical to phase 3 in how the kite is flown and how the winch behaves — a logging milestone only, marking the start of the window v_app is reported over
as 3/4, but reel-out is finished and the length setpoint frozen

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 786px; height: 1px; padding-top: 613px; margin-left: 688px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: left;

div.font:
Gain scaling. On top of the phase factor above, the steering gain is always scaled by v_app_ref / v_app — turn rate ~ u_s · v_app, so that is the plant gain.
Descent limiter. entry_chi_max, weighted by w_lim, applies wherever the guidance is far off the path, in any phase.
Feedback angle. Blended heading → course by kite speed in phases 0–2; with fig8_pure_course, phases 3+ use pure course feedback.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 376px; height: 1px; padding-top: 783px; margin-left: 688px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0px; text-align: left;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: normal;
div.font:
The 3/4 → 5 guard is tested outside the elseif ladder, so it can fire on the same step as 3 → 4: reel-out finishing does not wait for settling. It is also reachable from phase 3 directly — a run whose tracking never gets inside settled_d_gate still reaches final, which is why the results section gates the reel-out numbers on phase 3, not phase 4.
There is no transition out of phase 5, and no reel-in phase: this is a single reel-out, not a pumping cycle.

div.div:
Latched state — set exactly once, at the transition shown
hold_start — 1 → 2 — the hold_time timer
fig8_start — 2 → 3 — the reelout_delay and reelout_softstart timers
entry_sign — first time the descent limiter clips near ±180°, to keep the limited course's sign stable through the wrap
l_set — every reel-out / guard step — the position setpoint handed to step!, and the 3/4 → 5 guard
